name: Mechanical Repair Kits
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things.

It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... the Faire has been good to me.

Take these tickets, adventurer, and have fun!
narrative.requestItemsText:
The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken! I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!

Can you bring me those kits, adventurer? I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets. What do you say?
